description: flash step: still, then a sway and in 0.18 s the middle leg on one side shoots out sideways, lifted 30 mm, the body drops and leans 20 degrees away over the other side, twisting, the claw on that side flung out low and wide; snapped back, the other legs scuttle after it in steps lifted 25 mm, 80 mm over; left, right, left, right
